summary: A search box with a list of commands under it, grouped by heading, where a person can jump to a page, run an action, or pass what they typed to the agent. As soon as something is typed, the list narrows and a last row, "Ask the agent", sends the text to the agent instead. It gives an agent product one keyboard-first place to start anything.
use: When people need a single shortcut that reaches every page and action in your app.
When a typed request that matches no command should still reach the agent.
When you want to show keyboard shortcuts next to the commands they trigger.
Inside a modal opened by a key such as Cmd K, closed again with Escape.
features: Filters `items` as you type, matching the letters of the query in order anywhere in the label, and marks the matching letters.
Lists commands under their `group` heading, each with an icon and optional `keys` shown as keyboard chips.
Adds an "Ask the agent" row at the end whenever the box has text, which calls `onAsk` with that text.
Runs the highlighted command on click or Enter and calls `onRun` with it.
Shows what ran last in the footer, or your own `status` text.
Works controlled through `query` and `onQueryChange`, or holds its own text with `defaultQuery`.
a11y: The list has role="listbox" and each row has role="option" with aria-selected on the highlighted one.
The input is a `combobox` that points at the highlighted row with `aria-activedescendant`, so the focus stays in the box and the rows are not tab stops.
Arrow Up and Arrow Down move the highlight and wrap around, and Enter runs the highlighted row.
Escape clears the box first, and calls `onClose` only when the box is already empty.

faq.q: How do I send a free-text request to the agent?
faq.a: Pass `onAsk`. When the box has text, the last row reads "Ask the agent" with the typed text, and running it calls `onAsk` with the trimmed query.

faq.q: How does the filter match commands?
faq.a: Each letter of the query must appear in the label in the same order, though not side by side. So "tok" matches "Export tokens as CSS variables".

faq.q: How do I close the palette with Escape?
faq.a: Pass `onClose`. The first Escape clears any text, and the next Escape, on an empty box, calls `onClose` so you can hide the palette.

faq.q: Can I focus the input when the palette opens?
faq.a: Yes. Set `autoFocus` and the cursor goes into the box when it appears.
